newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Printing unit in newspaper deal.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Printing unit in newspaper deal.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Canada, a unit of Quebecor Printing Inc, said on Monday that it signed a two-year, multi-million dollar contract to print 17 weekly newspapers for Publications Dumont (1988) Inc.
Publications Dumont, a unit of Cogeco Inc, is one of Quebec's largest weekly newspaper publishers.
Quebecor Printing said that the new contract would require the addition of two coldset presses in its Saint-Jean, Quebec plant.
Quebecor Printing also announced plans to reorganize some of its Quebec printing plants to accommodate the expansion.

The company has signed a long-term lease for a new facility in Saint-Jean where it will relocate five presses from its St-Pierre Street location and one press from its LaSalle plant. An additional printing press will be added to the new facility as well, the company said.
The specialized coldset facility is expected to be completed by the end of 1996.
In a second phase, Quebecor Printing will open a heatset module in this plant in 1996.
The company also plans to set up a specialized bindery that will service several plants from the same location.

"The growth of this facility will be on a step by step basis, but the current market plan and investment plan when completed could result in doubling the current number of employees at Saint-Jean," Quebecor Printing said.
